recipe.visualDefinition: A central illustrative subject featuring a large, snarling brown grizzly bear standing upright, carrying a person in a bright yellow plush teddy bear costume on its back. The background is a textured, atmospheric deep red with subtle vignetting. Typography is placed horizontally across the mid-section, flanking the central figures.
coreVisualRelationships: The aggressive grizzly bear contrasts with the soft, round yellow costume.
The vibrant red background provides a high-contrast stage for the dark brown and bright yellow subjects.
Symmetry is established by the central vertical stack of the two figures.
coreInvariants: Piggyback pose between a wild animal and a costumed human
Heavy black outlines on the central characters

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally aligned, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The open, snarling mouth of the grizzly bear at the top-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the grizzly's face, moves down to the yellow costume's face, then outward to the text on either side.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample red space surrounding the central figures to emphasize isolation and intensity.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red background with painterly, mottled texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown fur of the grizzly bear.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright mustard yellow of the teddy bear costume.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background; high value contrast between the yellow costume and the dark brown bear.

letterConstructionRules: Small caps or all caps presentation

composition.position: Mid-height, left and right of center

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with color variation to distinguish primary and secondary text elements.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment across the center axis

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, modern geometric structure and weight.
Provides the classic geometric 'O' and sharp terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a painterly illustration on a textured deep red canvas. In the center, a large brown grizzly bear stands upright with its mouth open in a roar. It is carrying a person wearing a bright yellow, round teddy bear costume on its back. The style should have visible brushstrokes and thick black outlines around the characters.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply geometric sans-serif text in all caps. Place one phrase on the left side and another on the right side, centered vertically relative to the bear's torso. Use white for the left text and a golden yellow for the right text, with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the background a textured, mottled red?
Are there two distinct bears (one real, one costume) in a piggyback pose?
Is the text clean, geometric, and widely spaced?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red background texture
Shade of yellow for the costume
mustRedesign: Specific band names or album titles
Exact facial features of the person inside the costume
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the grizzly bear looks aggressive while the yellow bear looks soft.
Check that the text does not overlap the central illustration.
Verify the painterly texture is consistent across the red background.
Confirm the black outlines are bold and define the character shapes clearly.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central character stack + textured monochromatic background + flanking geometric typography.
